Personalised CMS Manual · Module Usage Guide

Arbortech – Theme Modules: What Each One Is For

What a "module" is

Every page on the storefront is assembled from theme sections – we call them modules. In Online Store → Themes → Customize, the left-hand panel lists the modules on the current page; Add section offers the library below. Each module has settings (fields you fill in) and some have repeatable blocks (items you add, remove and drag to reorder – cards, slides, FAQ items).

Two kinds of content

Some modules hold their content in their settings – what you type in the theme editor is what renders. Others are data-driven: they pull from products, metafields or metaobjects, and their settings only control headings and layout. The "Data source" line on each entry tells you which – for data-driven modules, edit the data (product, metafield, metaobject), not the module.

Theme edits are per-theme

Module settings live in the theme. Editing the live theme changes the live site immediately; and a rebuilt preview theme starts from the development copy's settings (Manual §5).

Heroes & banners

The big visual openers and full-width statement bands.

Page & Collection Hero arb-simple-hero-banner

The standard page/collection opener: a full-width image with an invisible (screen-reader-only) title. On collections it can pull the collection's own image and description automatically. (the workhorse hero – 41 templates.)

Settings (10): Content source, Padding Top, Image display, Use collection image, Show collection description, Fallback background image…

Vertical Hero arb-vertical-hero

The bigger editorial hero with visible eyebrow, heading, body copy and up to two buttons – used on the vertical gateways and landing pages. (used on 9 templates.)

Settings (16): Padding Top, Show side image, Heading tag, Layout, Light text on banner, Eyebrow…

Hero Carousel arb-hero-carousel

The homepage hero: autoplay slides, each with its own image, copy and link. (used on 1 template.)

Settings (5): Padding Top, Minimum height (desktop), Show scribble decoration, Auto rotate between slides, Change slides every  ·  Repeatable blocks: Slide

Parallax Quote arb-parallax-quote

The full-width parallax image band with a quote/statement over it – the signature break between page sections. Settings-driven on most pages; on product pages it can pull the quote from product metafields. (31 templates.)

Settings (13): Padding Top, Background image, Fallback image (theme asset filename), Eyebrow, Show dash and quotation mark, Quote…  ·  Data source: arbortech.quote, arbortech.quote_eyebrow, arbortech.quote_image

Promo Band arb-clever-engineering

The orange promo band ("Clever engineering" and siblings): eyebrow chip, big two-line heading, body and buttons, with alignment and show/hide toggles per element. (used on 11 templates.)

Settings (23): Padding Top, Remove bottom padding, Content position, Panel segment, Show eyebrow, Show heading…

Page Next Nav arb-page-next-nav

The "up next" footer band that walks visitors to the next page in a journey – pick the target page or set a custom title/link. (used on 4 templates.)

Settings (6): Next page, Custom title, Custom link, Theme, Padding Top, End of band (add bottom spacing)

Text & structure

Prose, headings and page scaffolding.

Story Text / Prose Column arb-our-story-text

The general prose module: rich-text column with optional eyebrow/heading/accent and buttons, in several layouts. When you need to add plain written content to a designed page, this is usually the module to reach for. (30 templates.)

Settings (16): Layout, Padding top, Full width, Center content, Remove bottom padding, Content…  ·  Repeatable blocks: Paragraph

Section Header arb-section-header

A standalone heading band (eyebrow + heading + accent word + optional body and CTA) used to introduce a following section. (used on 8 templates.)

Settings (8): Padding top, Eyebrow, Heading, Heading accent (orange line), Body, Button label…

Breadcrumbs arb-breadcrumbs

The breadcrumb trail. Automatic on products/collections; on pages the trail is composed from its crumb blocks. (54 templates.)

Settings (2): Padding Top, Home link label  ·  Repeatable blocks: Crumb

FAQ Accordion arb-faq

Accordion FAQ list – each question/answer is a block. On tool resource pages the FAQ content can come from metafields instead. (used on 2 templates.)

Settings (5): Padding Top, Heading, Heading accent (orange), Body text, End of band (add bottom spacing)  ·  Repeatable blocks: FAQ item  ·  Data source: arbortech.faq_body, arbortech.faq_heading, arbortech.faq_heading_accent

Triage Trio arb-triage-trio

The three-door chooser (e.g. Woodworking / Masonry / Landscaping) that routes visitors into the right vertical – three fixed card blocks. (used on 1 template.)

Settings (3): Padding Top, Use square cards, End of band (add bottom spacing)  ·  Repeatable blocks: Card

Cards, grids & showcases

The card-based layouts that make up most listing and hub pages.

The general-purpose card grid: each card is a block with image, eyebrow, title, copy and link; supports video cards, column count and an optional section header. Most hub pages are built from these. (31 templates.)

Product page modules

The modules that assemble a product page. Most are data-driven: the content lives on the product (metafields/metaobjects), and the module renders whatever the current product carries – the same template serves all 116 products.

Main Product arb-main-product

The buy box: gallery, price, variant/option pickers, market voltage routing, stock indicator and add-to-cart – plus the bundle configurator on MG1000/ALLSAW. Content comes from the product itself; settings are labels and toggles only. (used on 1 template.)

Settings (9): Configurator eyebrow, Market voltage eyebrow, Short tagline (2 lines), Vendor (fallback), Title (fallback), Price (fallback)…  ·  Repeatable blocks: Feature item  ·  Data source: arbortech.bundle_setup_value, arbortech.configurator_family, arbortech.legacy_kentico_au_url

Product Tabs arb-product-tabs

The What's Included / Specifications / Support tab band – populated from product metafields and linked documents. (used on 1 template.)

Settings (12): Full width, Accessibility label, Included tab label, Empty included text, Specifications tab label, Empty specifications text…

Product Story arb-product-story-panels

The long alternating image/text product story. Content is the Story panel metaobjects on each product (with per-market variants) – edit those under Settings → Custom data, not here (Manual, Blind Spots → Metafields). (14 templates.)

Settings (8): Content source, Padding Top, Heading, Eyebrow, Center header, Intro…  ·  Repeatable blocks: Story panel  ·  Data source: arbortech.product_story_sections, arbortech.product_story_sections_au, arbortech.product_story_sections_ca

Base theme modules

These ship with the underlying theme and run the structural pages. They rarely need touching, and several are safest left to us:

ModuleRole
header + announcement barThe site header, mega-menus (linked to the main menu + promo image blocks – Manual §4) and the optional announcement strip.
main-product familyBase product page engine – superseded on this store by the custom Main Product module.
main-collectionCollection listing with the custom filter sidebar (Vertical + By Product groups).
main-page / main-blog / main-articleRender standard pages, the News listing, and articles (including the designed story layouts).
main-cart / drawers / main-searchCart page, cart & search drawers.
main-not-foundThe 404 page (it also rescues old /en-au links – don't remove).
newsletter-popup, privacy-bannerSignup popup and the cookie/consent banner.
rich-text, related-products, contactGeneric text band, product recommendations, and the contact form (submissions go to the store contact inbox).
